text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help determine the cause of your jaundice and other symptoms, can you tell me if you have experienced any abdominal pain, and if so, where is it located?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't had any abdominal pain recently, but I did have a severe episode of upper abdominal pain three years ago. speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of painless jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, and pale stools strongly suggests a malignant obstruction of the bile ducts, likely pancreatic cancer. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Cancer
